title: flybot/01/cmd/motor and flybot/01/cmd/manual
description: Wheel command, QoS 0, not retained. cmd/motor: brain only, 20 Hz, obeyed in auto mode. cmd/manual: dashboard only, 10 Hz while driving, obeyed in manual mode. Contract sections 3.4 and 3.5.

l.description: Left wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

r.description: Right wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

rs.description: seq of the newest sensors message used (cmd/manual: newest seen by the dashboard, 0 if none).
